title: Didikadikwe
description: Mme Lenong o nkela Lenongnyana leetong la hae la pele la ho fofa. Leetong la bona, ba bona letsa le shwang. O bontsha mora wa hae hore pheletso ya bophelo ba phoofolo e nngwe e boetse ke qaleho ya mohato o motjha bakeng sa diphedi tse ding.
